headline: Edgecombe's three finishes a comeback from 17 down
dek: Down 17 in the first quarter, the 76ers went ahead for good on VJ Edgecombe’s three with 1:36 left.
three: 12 of 14 at the line, 6 rebounds and 3 blocks.
76ers down 17 in the first quarter, won the fourth 29–19
Embiid and Edgecombe combined for 50 of 121.
Won it at the line and in the fourth
Free throws made 23–9; fourth-quarter points 29–19. Orlando made 19 threes to Philadelphia’s 14.
